name: joplin-plugin-cockpit
description: A tasks-and-notes command center panel: due dates with drag and drop and a calendar picker, checkbox progress rings, notebook and search filters, view profiles, and notebook management - on desktop and mobile.

scripts.dist: webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.test:e2e: npm run dist && npm run setup:e2e && xvfb-run -a --server-args="-screen 0 1920x1080x24" playwright test
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force
